extras: Financial data remains in the vault as plain text files, allowing for version control with git and portability.
intentEvidence: Envelopes turns your Obsidian vault into a personal finance tracker.
motivation: To provide a personal finance tracker that keeps all financial data in plain Markdown files within the vault.
problem: Users need a way to manage personal finances and budgeting within Obsidian without relying on external cloud services or proprietary software.
summary: An envelope budgeting application that tracks personal finances, imports bank CSV data, and manages expenses directly within the Obsidian vault using Markdown files.
